cakeupdater.pack.uptodate: The modpack is up to date.
cakeupdater.pack.choose: How do you want to update to %s?
cakeupdater.pack.onclose: [Update when I close the game myself]
cakeupdater.pack.onclose.hover: Keep playing. The updater opens after you quit Minecraft.
cakeupdater.pack.now.hover: Quit Minecraft now and start the updater.
cakeupdater.pack.scheduled: The update will start when you close Minecraft.
cakeupdater.cancel.hover: Don't update when the game closes
cakeupdater.pack.no_installer: This install can't update itself: %s isn't in the game folder. Download it, put it in the game folder, then click update again.
cakeupdater.pack.folder.hover: Open the folder the installer goes in
cakeupdater.resourcepack.click.hover: Download it and reload resources (the game freezes for a few seconds)
cakeupdater.updated: Modpack updated (%s → %s). Your server list and configs from before the update are saved.
cakeupdater.updated.same: Modpack updated (%s). Your server list and configs from before the update are saved.
cakeupdater.restore.servers.hover: Put back the server list from before the update (the current one is saved first)
cakeupdater.restore.configs.hover: Put back the mod settings from before the update when you close Minecraft (the current ones are saved first)
cakeupdater.restore.servers.done: Server list from %s restored. Open the multiplayer screen to see it.
cakeupdater.restore.configs.scheduled: Configs from %s will be restored when you close Minecraft.
cakeupdater.quit.hover: Quit now; the configs are restored as the game closes
cakeupdater.backups.title: Backups: server list and configs
cakeupdater.backups.none: No backups yet. One is kept automatically before every modpack update.
cakeupdater.backups.servers.tip: Restore this server list now (the current one is saved first)
cakeupdater.backups.configs.tip: Put these files back when you close Minecraft (configs; for an import also options.txt and Xaero's data). The current ones are saved first
cakeupdater.pack.urgent: Urgent update: version %s was withdrawn. Please update to %s.
cakeupdater.pack.urgent.toast.title: Urgent modpack update
cakeupdater.pack.urgent.toast: Version %s was withdrawn. Join a world or server to update.
cakeupdater.changelog.open.hover: Everything that changed in this update
cakeupdater.changelog.title: Changelog
cakeupdater.memory.low: Minecraft has only %s GB of memory. Below %s GB it may stutter or run out of memory: raise it in your launcher's settings.
cakeupdater.memory.high: Minecraft has %s GB of memory. More than %s GB doesn't make it faster and causes longer pauses: lower it in your launcher's settings.
cakeupdater.import.offer: Coming from another pack or launcher? Bring your settings along: options and keybinds, UMM, Monumenta Addons, ChatPlus tabs, Xaero's waypoints and map, and your server list.
cakeupdater.import.offer.pick.hover: Choose your old .minecraft folder (or its instance folder). You see what was found before anything is copied.
cakeupdater.import.offer.off.hover: You can still import later with /cakeupdate import
cakeupdater.import.off: This message won't show again. You can still import with /cakeupdate import.
cakeupdater.import.picking: Choose your old .minecraft folder (or the instance folder around it) in the window that opens. It can open behind the game.
cakeupdater.import.picking.busy: The folder window is already open (it can be behind the game).
cakeupdater.import.picker.title: Choose your old .minecraft folder
cakeupdater.import.self: That's this game's own folder. Choose the .minecraft of your old pack or launcher.
cakeupdater.import.nothing: Nothing to import in %s (looked for options.txt, UMM, Monumenta Addons, ChatPlus, Xaero's maps and servers.dat).
cakeupdater.import.item.options: Options and keybinds (options.txt): replaces all of yours, also video settings and resource packs
cakeupdater.import.item.chatplus: ChatPlus windows and tabs, for CakeChat (they replace CakeChat's tabs)
cakeupdater.import.item.servers: Server list: %s servers you don't have yet are added
cakeupdater.import.confirm.hover: The files they replace are saved in a backup first (/cakeupdate backups)
cakeupdater.import.scheduled: The rest is copied when you close Minecraft, after every mod has saved its own files.
cakeupdater.import.quit.hover: Quit now; the import is copied as the game closes
cakeupdater.import.cancelled: Import cancelled. Nothing more will be copied.
cakeupdater.import.done: Imported %s files from %s. What they replaced is in the backup of %s.
cakeupdater.guide.welcome: Welcome to Monumenta Cakedition! The guide explains the pack's own mods, one page each.
cakeupdater.guide.updated: The pack was updated. The guide has a page for each of the pack's own mods.
cakeupdater.guide.open.hover: Opens the pack guide at "Cakedition's own mods"
